c4e: climate data for economists

Source: R/c4e-package.R
c4e-package.Rd

Links climate rasters to household surveys and computes weather extreme indicators for the reference period before each interview. Tables carry their context (variable, unit, time step, thresholds, windows) from one step to the next, so a value given once is not typed again.

Details

c4e succeeds climatic4economist, which stays available unchanged for existing scripts.

Options

  • c4e.verbose: FALSE silences the package's messages, progress steps and progress bars. Warnings and errors are always shown. rlang's rlib_message_verbosity = "quiet" also silences the messages.

  • c4e.mem_limit: memory budget for heavy steps, as bytes or a string such as "8GB". Steps whose estimated size exceeds it are split by unit and run piece by piece. The default is half of the free memory.

  • c4e.grid_rows: raster rows per block in the grid functions; by default from the memory budget.

  • c4e.grid_fast: FALSE sends sums of fixed-threshold days through the block engine instead of terra::tapp(); for checking.
